clips.title: Scoring for the National Team
grammar: 〜てくれる — doing something for someone
〜たいと思う — thinking of wanting to do

lines.ja: そして先日の代表戦でも見事ゴールを決めて、
lines.en: And in the recent national team match, you scored a great goal,
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: もう日本のサポーターを沸かせてくれましたよね。
lines.en: and really electrified the Japanese supporters.
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: あの試合、ご自身ではいかがでしたか？
lines.en: How did you personally feel about that match?
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: そろそろ代表でも点を取りたいと思ってたので、
lines.en: I'd been feeling that it was time to score for the national team,
lines.speaker: Ito

lines.en: so I'm really glad I did.
lines.speaker: Ito

clips.title: A Recent Expensive Purchase
grammar: 〜ぐらい — about / only to the extent of

lines.ja: 最近購入された大きな買い物などございますでしょうか？
lines.en: Have you made any big purchases recently?
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: いや本当に、ちょっと高い服を買ったぐらいです。
lines.en: Really, just bought some somewhat expensive clothes, that's about it.
lines.speaker: Ito

lines.ja: どんな、どんな服ですか？ちなみに。
lines.en: What kind of clothes, by the way?
lines.speaker: Interviewer

clips.title: Relaxing with Games Off-Season
grammar: 〜てほしくない — don't want someone to do / don't want to happen
〜ていらっしゃる — honorific ongoing action

lines.ja: 永久に無くなってほしくないものは？
lines.en: What is something you never want to disappear forever?
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: じゃあ、このオフに入って、
lines.en: So now that you're in the off-season,
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: ゲームを楽しんでらっしゃいますか？
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: そうですね、ゆっくり楽しめてます。
lines.en: Yeah, I've been able to take it easy and enjoy it.
lines.speaker: Ito

lines.ja: ああ、なるほど。ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Ah, I see. Thank you very much.
lines.speaker: Interviewer
